description: Valo's security baseline: each OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 requirement at Levels 1 and 2, with the control Valo has for it, the code that holds the control, and the tests and CI steps that show it, or the gap that is left, or the reason it does not apply. It is Valo's own map for an independent assessor, not an assessment or a certification (docs/architecture/security-baseline.md).
basis: VALO-TRD-001 v1.1, section 20: "Use OWASP ASVS Level 2 as the proposed application-security verification baseline. Map applicable controls to evidence; do not claim certification merely because a scanner was run. [S19]"

standard.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
standard.licence: The standard is CC BY-SA 4.0. This register holds only its identifiers and levels, and Valo's own words; read each requirement at the source.

statuses.met: Valo's code does what the requirement asks, and a test or CI step run on every merge shows it.
statuses.partly met: Part of it is done and shown; the gap names what is not done or not shown.
statuses.untested: Valo's code does it, but no test or CI step shows it yet; the gap names what would.
statuses.not met: Valo does not do it yet; the gap names what is needed.
statuses.not applicable: Valo has nothing the requirement is about; the reason says why.
statuses.identity provider: The sign-in provider, Clerk, does it for Valo; the reason says what the launch review must check, and the control what Valo does itself.
statuses.host: The hosting platform does it, once one is chosen for production; the reason says what to check at launch.
